mapper.sql: from student s where s.class_id in #{classId} and s.status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: select count(*) from student s where s.class_id in #{classId} and s.status = 'ACTIVE'
select max(ar.attendance_date) from attendance_record ar join student s on s.id = ar.student_id where s.class_id in #{classId} and s.status = 'ACTIVE'

select count(*) as registered_count, round(100.0 * sum(case when ar.status in ('PRESENT', 'LATE') then 1 else 0 end) / nullif(count(*), 0), 1) as attendance_rate from attendance_record ar join student s on s.id = ar.student_id where s.class_id in #{classId} and s.status = 'ACTIVE' and ar.attendance_date = #{date}
select name, target_value, current_value, unit, status from class_target where class_id in #{classId} order by id

select w.id, w.level, w.summary, s.name as student_name from warning_record w join student s on s.id = w.student_id where s.class_id in #{classId} and w.status = 'OPEN' order by w.created_at desc limit 50
